steps.text: Not every change is good for us. Some are helpful (desirable), some are harmful (undesirable). Let's sort a few.
Look at each change and decide if it helps us or harms us, then check your answer.
Cooking food and ripening fruit are desirable — we want them. Iron rusting and milk spoiling are undesirable — we try to prevent them.
The same kind of change can be desirable or undesirable depending on whether it helps us — that's what decides the label.

coach.mission: Sort each change into desirable or undesirable.
whenStuck: Ask: does this change help us or harm us?
whenWrong: Cooking and ripening help us (desirable); rusting and spoiling harm us (undesirable).
Think about whether we want the change to happen.
whenCorrect: Right — that change helps us, so it's desirable.
Right — that change harms us, so it's undesirable.
coach.done: You've sorted desirable and undesirable changes. Try more, or move on when you're ready.
